meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞、曲：Hannah Hobbs, Ben Tan

lines.a: 暗夜的火光 微弱盼望
lines.b: A spark in the night, a flame of hope

lines.a: 如同祢的靈 在我身上
lines.b: The Spirit of God within my soul

lines.a: 在我心中湧流 滲透我所有
lines.b: Alive within my heart, the life in my bones

lines.a: 祢讓我仰望 定睛於祢
lines.b: You're lifting my eyes towards You Lord

lines.a: 教導我心 更多貼近
lines.b: Teaching my heart to draw in close

lines.a: 祢烈火焚燒的靈 盼望永不止息
lines.b: To the all consuming God, our great unending hope

lines.a: 餘燼因祢名而甦醒 死灰復燃的生命
lines.b: As ember fans into flame, I'm revived within Your Name

lines.a: 祢聖靈正在運行 在我的裡面運行
lines.b: Your Spirit lives within me, Your Spirit lives within me

lines.a: 祢烈火焚燒我心 讓天堂大光降臨
lines.b: This fire burns in my soul, let the light of heaven glow

lines.a: 讓全地都看見祢 全地都看見祢
lines.b: For all the earth to see You, all the earth to see You

lines.a: 聖靈祢每天都帶領 發出真光引導我心
lines.b: Spirit You're leading me each day, casting a light to lead the way

lines.a: 呼召我跟隨祢 來與祢同行
lines.b: My guide to stay the path, You call me onwards

lines.a: 聖潔的火永遠掌權 祢榮耀充滿全世界
lines.b: Here in all holiness on earth, blazing forever glorious

lines.a: 祢烈火焚燒的靈 盼望永不止息
lines.b: You're the all consuming God, our great unending hope

lines.a: 祢聖靈火焰 煉淨我一切
lines.b: For all of this life, Your Spirit ignites

lines.a: 在地如在天 祢榮光彰顯
lines.b: A heavenly fire, untouched by the night

lines.a: 打開我雙眼 復活到永遠
lines.b: You open our eyes, turn death into life

lines.a: 祢真理掌權 祢超越一切
lines.b: Revealing all truth, there's no one like You
